aiva_rationale: Evaluated using the ClinGen Limb Girdle Muscular Dystrophy VCEP specifications for SGCG (doc_id: GN185, v2.0). SGCG:c.703-1G>C alters the canonical splice acceptor site of the final coding exon (exon 8) with a SpliceAI acceptor loss delta score of 0.92 (and cryptic acceptor gain of 0.199 at +37 bp, which is out-of-frame). Because this affects the last exon, nonsense-mediated decay (NMD) is not predicted, and the alteration disrupts the C-terminal 57 amino acids (~19.6% of the 291-aa protein, which includes the critical extracellular domain residue p.Cys283 mutated in LGMDR5). Following the PVS1 decision tree and ClinGen LGMD VCEP (GN185) guidelines, PVS1 is downgraded to Strong (4 points), and PP3 is not co-applied with PVS1 to avoid double-counting splicing predictions. The variant is absent from gnomAD, meeting PM2 at Supporting strength (1 point per GN185). Under the ClinGen LGMD VCEP (GN185) point system (Pathogenic >=10, Likely Pathogenic 6-9, Uncertain Significance 0-5), 1 Strong (4 points) + 1 Supporting (1 point) = 5 points, which classifies the variant as VUS (leaning pathogenic) (matching its ClinVar classification in VCV000836267).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA1 and BRCA2 VCEP specifications for BRCA2 (GN097, v1.2). Three pathogenic criteria are met: PP4 at Very Strong strength (combined multifactorial likelihood ratio = 406:1 >= 350:1 threshold from cosegregation LR=1.88, co-occurrence LR=1.28, and family history LR=168.6; PMID:17924331, PMID:31853058), PS3 at Strong strength (multiple calibrated functional assays including HDR and high-throughput survival assays demonstrating loss of function; PMID:29884841, PMID:29988080, PMID:32444794, PMID:33609447), and PM2 at Supporting strength (absent from gnomAD v2.1/v3.1 non-cancer control subsets). Computational prediction (BayesDel_noAF = 0.25205) falls in the intermediate uninformative range (0.18-0.30) inside the DNA-binding domain (aa 2481-3186) with no splicing impact (SpliceAI = 0.067 <= 0.10), so neither PP3 nor BP4 applies. Combining 1 Very Strong (PP4_VeryStrong), 1 Strong (PS3), and 1 Supporting (PM2_Supporting) satisfies the ACMG/AMP rule for Pathogenic (1 Very Strong + >=1 Strong, or >=2 Strong even if PP4 is capped at Strong), with an ACMG point score of 13.

Two Pathogenic Supporting criteria are met: PM2 (applied at Supporting strength for absence in gnomAD, well below the <=0.00004 threshold) and PP3 (applied at Supporting strength for REVEL = 0.918, exceeding the >=0.70 threshold). Strength counts: 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 2 Pathogenic Supporting, and 0 Benign criteria (ACMG score = 2). Note that ClinVar Expert Panel review (ClinVar:43085) also lists this variant as Uncertain significance for primary dilated cardiomyopathy.

Pathogenic criteria met: 1 Supporting (PM2, as the variant is absent from gnomAD non-cancer databases). Benign criteria met: 1 Supporting (BP7 [RNA], based on functional minigene splicing assay data in PMID:31191615 showing 100% normal canonical exon 14 splicing with no aberrant transcripts, weighted at Supporting for a single study; even if weighted at BP7_Strong per GN097, 1 BS alone does not reach Likely Benign). Computational splicing prediction via SpliceAI (max_delta = 0.124 for acceptor loss) falls in the uninformative intermediate zone (0.10 < 0.124 < 0.20), meeting neither PP3 (>=0.20) nor BP4 (<=0.10) per GN097. With 1 Pathogenic Supporting (+1) and 1 Benign Supporting (-1) (net ACMG score = 0), neither Likely Pathogenic nor Likely Benign combining thresholds are met, resulting in a Variant of Uncertain Significance. Because experimental mRNA splicing analysis directly tested the splice acceptor region of exon 14 and demonstrated normal canonical transcript production, the evidence leans benign: VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Cardiomyopathy Expert Panel Specifications for MYH7 Version 2.0 (GN002). Three pathogenic criteria are met from verifiable session evidence: 1 Moderate (PM1: missense variant at codon 868 within the MYH7 HCM cluster region codons 167-931) and 2 Supporting (PM2: gnomAD v4.1 popmax AC=1/1,180,048, AF=8.474e-7, meeting the <=0.00004 threshold; PP3: REVEL=0.879, meeting the >=0.70 threshold). No benign criteria are met. Under the GN002 combining rules, 1 Moderate + 2 Supporting criteria do not reach the minimum threshold for Likely Pathogenic (which requires at least 1M + 4P, 2M + 2P, 3M, 1S + 1M, or 1S + 2P; note that ClinVar VCV000177847 / ClinGen:CA012698 lists Likely Pathogenic based on internal/published case-level or segregation counts not present in the indexed PubTator text passages). Therefore, based strictly on the verifiable evidence available, the variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic) with an ACMG score of 4 (2 + 1 + 1).

Although ClinVar lists this variant as Pathogenic (ClinVar:14090) and literature reports p.Gly584Arg in HCM families (PMID:1552912, PMID:8250038, PMID:39605252), retrieved literature passages do not provide unmatched case-control cohort denominators reaching a lower 95% CI of OR >=5 (PS4) or verifiable single-variant segregation counts >=3 (PP1) independent of digenic inheritance (PMID:39605252). Under the GN002 VCEP combining rules, 1 Moderate + 2 Supporting criteria (ACMG score = 4) do not reach the threshold for Likely Pathogenic (which requires at least 2 Moderate + 2 Supporting, 1 Moderate + 4 Supporting, or 1 Strong + 1 Moderate/2 Supporting), resulting in a classification of VUS (leaning pathogenic).

The variant NM_000257.4:c.1012G>A (p.Val338Met) meets 1 Pathogenic Moderate criterion (PM1: located at codon 338 within the validated HCM cluster region of codons 167-931) and 2 Pathogenic Supporting criteria (PM2: absent from gnomAD / population databases, below the <=0.00004 threshold; PP3: REVEL score of 0.734, meeting the >=0.70 threshold). aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Rett and Angelman-like Disorders VCEP specifications for FOXG1 (doc_id: GN035, v6.0). Three pathogenic criteria are met: 1 Moderate (PM1: residue 267 is within the Forkhead domain aa 181-275 defined in GN035) and 2 Supporting (PM2: absent from control population databases with AF=0; PP3: REVEL=0.798 >= 0.644 threshold in GN035). aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen RASopathy VCEP specifications for SOS2 (GN042, Version 2.3). Met criteria counts: 1 Benign Stand-Alone (BA1: -8), 1 Benign Strong (BS1: -4), and 1 Pathogenic Moderate (PM4: +2), yielding an ACMG score of -10. The gnomAD African population allele frequency (0.1324% in genomes, 0.07766% in exomes) and overall genomes allele frequency (0.03809%) exceed both the VCEP BA1 threshold (>=0.05%) and BS1 threshold (>=0.025%). Although PM4 is met at Moderate strength because c.3755_3757del (p.Ile1252del) is a 1-amino-acid in-frame deletion and SOS2 lacks known repetitive regions per GN042, a single Pathogenic Moderate criterion does not reach Likely Pathogenic or Pathogenic under GN042 combining rules, whereas 1 Benign Stand-Alone criterion (BA1) directly satisfies the GN042 combining rule 'Benign: 1 Benign Stand Alone' (and BS1 independently satisfies 'Likely Benign: 1 Benign Strong'). Therefore, the variant is classified as Benign.

The variant NM_001195573.1:c.5365-142del is a deep intronic 2-bp deletion in the clinical RefSeq transcript (and canonical RefSeq NM_177438.3), despite an alternative Ensembl GRCh37 transcript model (ENST00000526495.1) annotating it as a 3' frameshift. Only 1 Pathogenic Supporting criterion (PM2: absent from gnomAD) and 1 Benign Supporting criterion (BP4: SpliceAI max_delta=0.055 <= 0.10 predicting no splice impact per Walker 2023) are met, yielding an ACMG point score of 0 (1 P = +1, 1 BP = -1). Neither Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic nor Benign/Likely Benign combining thresholds are met; given the deep intronic location in the primary RefSeq transcript with benign splice predictions and no case or functional evidence, the variant is classified as VUS (leaning benign).

Met criteria comprise 1 Pathogenic Strong (PP1 applied at Strong for >=7 segregations across HCM families), 2 Pathogenic Moderate (PS4 applied at Moderate for enrichment in unrelated HCM probands vs controls; PM5 applied at Moderate for occurring at the same codon as established pathogenic variant p.Arg403Gln, taking precedence over PM1 per GN002 to avoid double-counting), and 3 Pathogenic Supporting (PS3 applied at Supporting for in vitro motility and biochemical assays; PM2 applied at Supporting for gnomAD popmax AF <=0.00004; PP3 applied at Supporting for REVEL=0.822 >=0.70). aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Rett and Angelman-like Disorders Expert Panel Specifications for UBE3A v7.0 (doc_id:GN037). Six pathogenic criteria are met: 1 Strong (PS3: replicated functional assays in PMID:33607653 and PMID:34815418 demonstrating cytoplasmic mislocalization, reduced protein stability, and loss of E3 ubiquitin ligase activity), 2 Moderate (PS4 applied at Moderate for 3-4 independent affected observations across PMID:10647895, PMID:19213023, and PMID:23708187; PM5 at Moderate based on pathogenic p.Arg526His / p.Arg506His at the same residue in PMID:34365610 and PMID:34815418 with Grantham 180 > 29), and 3 Supporting (PM2 applied at Supporting for absence from gnomAD; PP1 at Supporting for maternal co-segregation in affected siblings in PMID:23708187; PP3 at Supporting for REVEL=0.866 >= 0.644). Under the GN037 combining rules, 1 Pathogenic Strong + 2 Pathogenic Moderate + >=2 Pathogenic Supporting yields a classification of Pathogenic (ACMG score = 4 + 2 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 11).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated according to the ClinGen Limb Girdle Muscular Dystrophy VCEP specification for CAPN3 (doc_id: GN187, Version 2.0). Four pathogenic criteria are met: PP4 at Strong strength (4 points; progressive limb-girdle weakness with reduced/absent calpain-3 protein in patient muscle biopsy per PMID:18055493 and PMID:20694146), PM2 at Supporting strength (1 point; absent in gnomAD v2.1.1/v3.1.1 and gnomAD v4.1 Grpmax 95% CI upper bound 1.23e-5 < 0.0001), PM3 at Supporting strength (1 point; 0.5 PM3 points from observations with pathogenic c.1319G>A p.Arg440Gln in unknown phase per PMID:18055493, PMID:18334579, PMID:20694146), and PP3 at Supporting strength (1 point; REVEL = 0.859 >= 0.70). Under the ClinGen VCEP GN187 point-based combining rules, 1 Strong (4 pts) + 3 Supporting (3 pts) yields a total of 7 points, which satisfies the rule for Likely Pathogenic (points >= 6 and <= 9; also 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting under standard ACMG/AMP 2015 rules).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen FBN1 Variant Curation Expert Panel specifications (GN022, v1.0). Four pathogenic criteria are met: 1 Moderate (PM1: cysteine-creating substitution p.Gly2668Cys in a cbEGF-like domain) and 3 Supporting (PM2_Supporting: absent from population databases with AF < 0.0005%; PP2: missense variant in a missense-constrained gene with mis_z = 8.60 and supporting pathogenic evidence without benign evidence; PP3: REVEL = 0.987 >= 0.75). Under standard ACMG/AMP combining rules, 1 Moderate + 3 Supporting criteria (ACMG score = 5) falls one supporting criterion short of the Likely Pathogenic threshold (which requires 1 Moderate + >=4 Supporting or >=2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting), resulting in a classification of VUS (leaning pathogenic). Note: while ClinVar (VCV000381609) lists an expert panel Likely Pathogenic assertion, unpublished clinical proband/segregation/phenotype data (such as PS4, PP1, or PP4 via revised Ghent criteria) are not available in indexed literature or the provided clinical context and therefore cannot be applied.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated according to the ClinGen FBN1 Variant Curation Expert Panel specifications (doc_id:GN022) and ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules. NM_000138.5:c.8326C>T (p.Arg2776Ter) is a nonsense variant in the last coding exon of FBN1 predicted to escape nonsense-mediated decay (NMD), truncating the C-terminal propeptide domain (residues 2732-2871 per UniProt:P35555), which satisfies PVS1 at Strong strength (PVS1_Strong) under ClinGen FBN1 VCEP rules. Excluding Finnish, Ashkenazi Jewish, and Other/Remaining populations as mandated by the ClinGen FBN1 VCEP (doc_id:GN022), the variant is absent from all remaining gnomAD populations (highest non-excluded ethnic population AF = 0.0 < 5.0e-6), satisfying PM2 at Supporting strength (PM2_Supporting) and not meeting BS1. Combining 1 Strong (PVS1_Strong) and 1 Supporting (PM2_Supporting) criterion yields an ACMG score of 5 (4 + 1). Under the standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules (where Likely Pathogenic requires 1 Very Strong + 1 Supporting [ClinGen SVI 2020], 1 Strong + 1-2 Moderate, or 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting), 1 Strong + 1 Supporting does not reach the threshold for Likely Pathogenic, resulting in a classification of VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated according to the ClinGen FBN1 Variant Curation Expert Panel specifications (GN022, Version 1.0). Seven pathogenic criteria are met: 2 Strong (PS4 at Strong, PP1 applied at Strong for >5 segregations), 2 Moderate (PM1 at Moderate for a cysteine-creating missense variant in cbEGF-like domain 41, PM6 at Moderate with 1.25 de novo points), and 3 Supporting (PM2 at Supporting with gnomAD v4.1 NFE popmax AF = 0.0001695% < 0.0005%, PP2 at Supporting for a missense variant in constrained FBN1 with other pathogenic evidence and no benign evidence, and PP4 at Supporting for probands fulfilling revised Ghent criteria). Notably, PP3 and BP4 are not met because REVEL = 0.686 falls in the indeterminate range between the GN022 thresholds of 0.326 and 0.75. Under ACMG/AMP and GN022 combining rules, both rule (b) (>=2 Strong: 2 Strong met) and rule (c) (1 Strong + 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting: 2 Strong, 2 Moderate, 3 Supporting met) are satisfied, yielding a classification of Pathogenic with an ACMG score of 15 (2*4 + 2*2 + 3*1 = 15).

The variant NM_000138.5:c.6662G>A (p.Cys2221Tyr) substitutes a conserved disulfide-bonding cysteine residue within calcium-binding EGF-like domain 38 of FBN1, fulfilling PM1 at Strong strength (PM1_Strong); per the VCEP specification caveat for PM1_Strong, PM5/PS1 are excluded to avoid double-counting. The variant is absent from gnomAD population databases (PM2_Supporting), occurs in a missense-constrained gene (gnomAD mis_z = 8.60) alongside other pathogenic evidence without benign evidence (PP2_Supporting), and has a damaging REVEL score of 0.965 exceeding the VCEP threshold of 0.75 (PP3_Supporting). Combining 1 Strong (PM1_Strong) and 3 Supporting (PM2_Supporting, PP2_Supporting, PP3_Supporting) criteria satisfies the ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rule for Likely Pathogenic (1 Strong + >=2 Supporting; total ACMG points = 4 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 7).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen FBN1 Variant Curation Expert Panel specifications (doc_id: GN022) and standard ACMG/AMP combining rules. Five criteria are met at Supporting strength (0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 5 Supporting; acmg_score = 5): PS4_Supporting (reported in unrelated probands fulfilling revised Ghent criteria for Marfan syndrome, totaling 1-1.5 points), PM2_Supporting (absent from gnomAD, AF < 0.0005%), PP2_Supporting (missense variant in missense-constrained FBN1 with mis_z = 8.60, accompanied by other pathogenic arguments and no benign arguments), PP3_Supporting (REVEL = 0.883 >= 0.75 VCEP threshold), and PP4_Supporting (probands fulfil revised Ghent criteria). Notably, although p.Cys67Arg disrupts a disulfide-forming cysteine (Cys67-Cys80), residue 67 lies in the N-terminal FUN (4-Cys motif) domain (residues 45-81) rather than the cbEGF, EGF-like, TB, or hybrid domains strictly required for PM1 by GN022, and alternative pathogenic substitutions at Cys67 or higher proband point totals could not be independently verified from accessible primary literature. Under the combining rules, 5 Supporting criteria without a Strong or Moderate criterion do not reach the threshold for Likely Pathogenic (which requires at least 1 Moderate + >=4 Supporting, or 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting), resulting in a classification of VUS (leaning pathogenic).

Four criteria are met at Pathogenic Supporting strength (0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 4 Supporting): PS3 (applied at Supporting strength for functional studies demonstrating RAF-dependent MEK/ERK activation in PMID:36442478, PMID:37830744, and PMID:18060073), PS4 (applied at Supporting strength for an affected proband with autosomal dominant cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome type 3 in PMID:38516188 and RASopathy cohort links in PMID:17704260 and PMID:29402968), PM2 (applied at Supporting strength for complete absence in gnomAD per VEP), and PP2 (applied at Supporting strength for MAP2K1 missense constraint mis_z=4.48 > 3.09 per gnomad_constraint). Under GN045 combining rules, 4 Supporting pathogenic criteria without a Moderate or Strong criterion do not meet the threshold for Likely Pathogenic (which requires at least 1 Moderate + >=4 Supporting, 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting, >=3 Moderate, 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting, or 1 Strong + 1 Moderate), resulting in a classification of VUS (leaning pathogenic) with an ACMG score of 4.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen ACADVL Variant Curation Expert Panel specifications (doc_id: GN021, version 2.2; PMID:37549443). The variant NM_001270448.2:c.1599+1G>A (corresponding to MANE Select transcript NM_000018.4:c.1827+1G>A at chr17:7128204G>A, GRCh37) disrupts the canonical +1 GT donor splice site of intron 19 (which is not the excluded GC donor site of intron 8). Per GN021 PVS1 rules, canonical +1/+2 donor variants are predicted to skip the immediately 5' exon (exon 19, 76 bp, out-of-frame), supporting PVS1 at Very Strong strength (1 Pathogenic Very Strong = 8 points). PP3 is not applied in conjunction with PVS1 per GN021 rules despite a SpliceAI donor loss delta score of 0.977. The variant is absent from gnomAD in both VEP and MyVariant annotations, meeting PM2 at Supporting strength per GN021 (<0.1% MAF cutoff; 1 Pathogenic Supporting = 1 point). No published case-level clinical, biochemical, or allelic data were found in PubMed/PubTator3 to support PS3, PM3, or PP4. Under the ClinGen ACADVL VCEP combining rules (GN021), 1 Pathogenic Very Strong (PVS1) + 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2_Supporting) classifies the variant as Likely Pathogenic (ACMG score = 9).

The variant NM_001369369.1:c.1585del (ENST00000226247.2:c.1586_1587del, p.Leu529ArgfsTer9) is a frameshift occurring at codon 529 (after c.1577 / codon 526 in the last 50 nucleotides of penultimate exon 8), where it is not predicted to undergo nonsense-mediated decay. However, because it disrupts the critical C-terminal transactivation domain (amino acids 511-563; PMID:10767081), it meets PVS1 at Strong strength (PVS1_Strong) per VCEP GN113 rules. Under the VCEP GN113 combining rules, 1 Pathogenic Strong (PVS1_Strong) + 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2_Supporting) does not reach the threshold for Likely Pathogenic (which requires 1 Strong + >=1 Moderate, or 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting), resulting in a classification of VUS (leaning pathogenic) with an ACMG point score of 5 (4 + 1).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA1 and BRCA2 Expert Panel Specifications (Version 1.2, doc_id: GN092). NM_007294.4:c.5333-36_5406+400del is a 510 bp sequence-level deletion encompassing all 74 coding bases of exon 21 (legacy exon 22) and flanking intronic splice sites. Deletion of this 74 bp exon disrupts the reading frame and introduces a premature termination codon upstream of p.Leu1854, truncating the clinically essential C-terminal BRCT repeats domain (aa 1650-1857) in BRCA1, satisfying PVS1 at Very Strong strength. Additionally, per the ENIGMA BRCA1 VCEP specification (GN092) for premature termination codons (PM5_PTC) and the ClinGen Evidence Repository curation (CA10602571 / ClinVar:267601), PTCs resulting in termination within exon 23 upstream of p.Ile1855 qualify for PM5 at Strong strength. PM2_Supporting is not applied per GN092 due to suboptimal recall of multi-hundred-bp deletions in gnomAD short-read datasets. Combining 1 Very Strong (PVS1) and 1 Strong (PM5_Strong) criterion yields a classification of Pathogenic (ACMG score = 8 + 4 = 12) under the ACMG/AMP combining rules (1 VS + >=1 S -> Pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated using the ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA1 and BRCA2 VCEP specifications (GN092 v1.2). NM_007294.4:c.305C>G (p.Ala102Gly) is a missense substitution at amino acid 102, immediately outside the BRCA1 RING domain (aa 2-101) and outside the coiled-coil (aa 1391-1424) and BRCT (aa 1650-1857) domains, with no predicted effect on splicing (SpliceAI max delta = 0.001 <= 0.1), fulfilling BP1 at Strong strength (BP1_Strong, counting as 1 Benign Strong [BS] criterion; ACMG score = -4). No other pathogenic or benign criteria are met from the available population, computational, and literature evidence. Under the ACMG/AMP combining rules, 1 Benign Strong criterion alone (1 BS, 0 BP) is insufficient to reach Benign (>=2 BS or 1 BA1) or Likely Benign (1 BS + >=1 BP or >=2 BP), resulting in a classification of VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA1 and BRCA2 VCEP specification (GN092, v1.2). Three pathogenic criteria are met: 1 Strong (PS3: damaging effect in calibrated saturation genome editing and BRCT transcriptional/HDR functional assays) and 2 Supporting (PM2_Supporting: absent from gnomAD/ALFA population databases; PP3_Supporting: missense variant within the BRCA1 BRCT functional domain aa 1650-1857 with BayesDel_noAF=0.398132 >= 0.28). Because GN092 specifies criterion-level rules and only overrides stand-alone benign in its combining_rules field, the standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rule for 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting (1S + 2P; acmg_score = 4 + 1 + 1 = 6) classifies this variant as Likely Pathogenic.

On the benign side, BP7 is met at Strong strength (1 BS: BP7_Strong RNA based on functional mRNA minigene splicing assay showing normal splicing r.[=] in PMID:24667779) and BS1 is met at Supporting strength (1 BP: BS1_Supporting based on gnomAD NFE AF=6.221e-05 in exomes / 0.0001176 in genomes, corresponding to filter allele frequency between 0.002% and 0.01% per GN092). aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA1 and BRCA2 VCEP specifications v1.2 (doc_id: GN092). The variant NM_007294.4:c.81-11del (17:41267807:AGG:A, GRCh37) is an intronic deletion within the polypyrimidine tract. It is absent from gnomAD population databases via Ensembl VEP, satisfying PM2 at Supporting strength (1 Pathogenic Supporting). SpliceAI predicts no splicing impact (max delta score = 0.013 for acceptor gain, well below the <= 0.1 threshold), satisfying BP4 at Supporting strength (1 Benign Supporting). BP7 is not met because the variant lies within the -20 to -3 acceptor motif region (at -11 to -13) rather than at or beyond +7/-21, and no RNA functional studies exist. With 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2, +1 point) and 1 Benign Supporting (BP4, -1 point), net ACMG score is 0, which does not meet criteria for Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic or Benign/Likely Benign. Because it is an intronic variant with no predicted splicing impact (SpliceAI = 0.013) and only population absence supporting pathogenicity, it is classified as VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications for ITGA2B (doc_id: GN011, v2.1; PMID:33496739). Although NM_000419.5:c.3091del (p.Leu1031TrpfsTer?) is a frameshift variant, it occurs in the final exon (exon 30) within the distal cytoplasmic tail at residue 1031 of 1039 (removing <1% of the protein), downstream of both the transmembrane domain (residues 994-1019) and the critical cytoplasmic GFFKR motif (residues 1022-1026) per UniProt:P08514, and is not predicted to undergo NMD. Under the ClinGen SVI PVS1 decision tree and GN011 (which marks PVS1_Strong and PVS1_Moderate as Not Applicable and requires truncation of a region critical to protein function for PVS1), PVS1 is not met. The variant is absent from population databases per VEP (PM2 applied at Supporting strength per GN011) and has been reported in compound heterozygosity with the pathogenic ITGA2B missense variant p.Ile596Thr in a patient with Type I Glanzmann thrombasthenia (PMID:29385657; PMID:25373348), supporting PM3 at Supporting strength and PP4 at Supporting strength. Combining 3 Supporting pathogenic criteria (0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 3 Supporting; ACMG score = 3) does not meet the threshold for Likely Pathogenic and results in a classification of VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications for ITGA2B (GN011; PMID:33496739) for autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia. Four pathogenic criteria are met: PVS1 (1 Very Strong = 8 points; also curated at PVS1_Strong by the VCEP due to frameshift-induced stop-loss altering the critical transmembrane domain, aa 994-1019 per UniProt:P08514), PP4 (1 Moderate = 2 points; up to Strong with full sequencing of ITGA2B and ITGB3 in patient TGP0086, PMID:31064749), PM2 (1 Supporting = 1 point; absent from gnomAD), and PM3 (1 Supporting = 1 point; homozygous in affected probands in PMID:31064749 and PMID:22190468). Combining 1 Very Strong + 1 Moderate + 2 Supporting criteria (score = 12) fulfills the ACMG/AMP combining rules for Pathogenic (1 VS + >=1 M + >=1 P, and 1 VS + >=2 P; also Pathogenic as 2 Strong when PVS1_Strong and PP4_Strong are combined per ClinGen ERepo:CA915940799).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications for ITGA2B (doc_id:GN011, Version 2.1). Three criteria are met at Moderate strength—PS3 (applied at Moderate for markedly reduced alphaIIb-beta3 surface expression in heterologous CHO-beta3 cells and abnormal exon 28 skipping in PMID:17018384), PM3 (applied at Moderate for compound heterozygosity in trans with pathogenic nonsense variant p.Arg584Ter in PMID:17018384), and PP4 (applied at Moderate for the highly specific Type II Glanzmann thrombasthenia clinical and flow cytometry/western blot phenotype in PMID:17018384)—along with one criterion at Supporting strength, PM2 (applied at Supporting for absence from gnomAD). aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications for ITGA2B (GN011 v2.1). The variant NM_000419.5:c.2444_2445del (p.Tyr815Ter) introduces a frameshift and immediate premature termination codon at residue 815 of 1039 in ITGA2B, which is predicted to cause nonsense-mediated mRNA decay in a gene where loss of function is a well-established mechanism for autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia (PVS1 at Very Strong). The variant is completely absent from gnomAD population databases, satisfying the VCEP threshold of <0.0001 allele frequency (PM2 at Supporting). No proband-specific clinical or laboratory phenotype details or segregation/allelic data were provided, so PP4 and PM3 are not met. Combining 1 Very Strong (PVS1) and 1 Supporting (PM2_Supporting) criterion yields a classification of Likely Pathogenic per ClinGen SVI / ACMG combining rules (ACMG score = 8 + 1 = 9).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Platelet Disorders Expert Panel Specifications Version 2.1 (doc_id: GN011) for ITGA2B in autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia. Three pathogenic criteria are met: PP4 applied at Strong strength (1 Strong: proband Case 36 in PMID:28983057 with mucocutaneous bleeding, ISTH-BAT=6, classic GT aggregometry and flow cytometry showing absent/markedly reduced GPIIb/IIIa expression with normal GPIb/IX, and full sequencing of both ITGA2B and ITGB3), PM3 applied at Supporting strength (1 Supporting: homozygous occurrence in a consanguineous proband, 0.5 points per SVI PM3 point system specified by GN011), and PM2 applied at Supporting strength (1 Supporting: gnomAD v4.1 AF=1.86e-6 and popmax AF=3.33e-5, below the <0.0001 VCEP threshold). Computational evidence (REVEL=0.394) falls in the indeterminate range between the VCEP thresholds for PP3 (>=0.70) and BP4 (<0.25), meeting neither. Combining 1 Strong (PP4_Strong) and 2 Supporting (PM2_Supporting, PM3_Supporting) criteria yields a classification of Likely Pathogenic (rule: 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting; ACMG score = 4 + 1 + 1 = 6), matching the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP expert panel curation (ClinGen:CA399799766 / ClinVar:1210185).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated according to the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications (GN011 v2.1) for ITGA2B in autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia. Only PM2 (applied at Supporting strength: 1 Pathogenic Supporting, +1 point) is met based on an overall gnomAD allele frequency <0.0001 (exomes AF = 6.842e-6, genomes AF = 1.315e-5). Under ClinGen VCEP GN011 verbatim rules, BP4 specifies REVEL < 0.25 (missense-only) and BP7 is unmodified (synonymous variants), so neither benign computational code is formally applied despite SpliceAI showing no splicing impact (max_delta = 0.013 <= 0.1) for this +9 intronic variant. Because 1 Pathogenic Supporting criterion alone does not meet thresholds for Likely Pathogenic or Pathogenic, and the variant is an intronic substitution with no predicted splice effect and no clinical or functional evidence of pathogenicity, it is classified as VUS (leaning benign) per the calibration guidelines for variants with at most one weak supporting criterion.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications (doc_id:GN011, v2.1) for ITGA2B-related autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia. Six pathogenic criteria are met: 1 Strong (PS3: absent alphaIIbbeta3 surface expression in cotransfected CHO cells per PMID:15219201), 2 Moderate (PP1_Moderate: co-segregation in proband plus 2 affected homozygous relatives; PP4_Moderate: classic mucocutaneous bleeding, absent platelet aggregation, and absent alphaIIbbeta3 on platelet FACS per PMID:15219201), and 3 Supporting (PM2_Supporting: absent in gnomAD; PM3_Supporting: 1 homozygous proband = 0.5 SVI points; PP3_Supporting: REVEL = 0.781 >= 0.70). Under the ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules, 1 Strong + 2 Moderate + 3 Supporting satisfies the rule for Pathogenic (1 S + 2 M + >=2 P), yielding a total ACMG score of 11.

With 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, and 2 Supporting pathogenic criteria (ACMG score = 2) and 0 benign criteria, the variant does not reach the threshold for Likely Pathogenic and is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

Met criteria comprise 1 Strong (PS3_Strong: <5% surface expression of alphaIIbbeta3 in co-transfected COS7 cells, PMID:12181054), 2 Moderate (PM3_Moderate: observed in trans with pathogenic ITGA2B variants across multiple unrelated GT probands, PMID:25728920, PMID:12181054, PMID:34066320; PP4_Moderate: probands with clinical and laboratory diagnosis of type I Glanzmann thrombasthenia and sequencing of both ITGA2B and ITGB3, PMID:25728920, PMID:34066320), and 2 Supporting (PM2_Supporting: gnomAD v4.1 AF = 0.00000124, below the 0.0001 cutoff; PP3_Supporting: REVEL = 0.859, meeting the >= 0.7 threshold). aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications (doc_id: GN011, v2.1) for ITGA2B in autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia. Five pathogenic criteria are met: 1 Strong (PP4 applied at Strong based on pathognomonic clinical and platelet aggregation/expression phenotype with full sequencing of ITGA2B and ITGB3 in PMID:22394243 and PMID:25728920), 2 Moderate (PM3 at Moderate for confirmed in trans compound heterozygosity with pathogenic variant c.1440-13_1440-1del in PMID:22394243; PP1 at Moderate for co-segregation of both variants in the proband plus 2 affected siblings in PMID:22394243), and 2 Supporting (PM2 at Supporting for absence in gnomAD; PP3 at Supporting for REVEL = 0.797 >= 0.7). No benign criteria are met. Under standard ACMG/AMP combining rules, 1 Strong + 2 Moderate + 2 Supporting satisfies Pathogenic rule (c) [1 S + 2 M + >=2 P], yielding a classification of Pathogenic (ACMG score = 10).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Platelet Disorders Expert Panel Specifications to the ACMG/AMP Variant Interpretation Guidelines Version 2.1 (doc_id:GN011) for autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia. Two Moderate criteria (PM3 at Moderate strength based on 1 homozygous proband GT-4 and 1 compound heterozygous proband GT-11 in PMID:25539746; PP4 at Moderate strength based on classic Glanzmann thrombasthenia clinical and platelet laboratory phenotype in PMID:25539746) and two Supporting criteria (PM2 at Supporting strength due to absence in gnomAD and AF <0.0001; PP3 at Supporting strength based on REVEL=0.953 >=0.7 and >2 damaging in silico predictions in VEP) are met, with no benign criteria met. Under the ACMG/AMP combining rules (2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting), this combination classifies the variant as Likely Pathogenic (ACMG score = 2*2 + 2*1 = 6).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications (doc_id: GN011, v2.1) and standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules. Met criteria provide 1 Moderate (PM5) and 2 Supporting (PM2_Supporting, PP3_Supporting) pathogenic evidence points (ACMG score = 2 + 1 + 1 = 4) and 0 benign criteria. aiva_rationale: Evaluated using the ClinGen Platelet Disorders Expert Panel Specifications (GN011, v2.1) for ITGB3-related autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia. Two Moderate criteria (PM3_Moderate for compound heterozygosity with pathogenic nonsense variant p.Asn470Ter in PMID:29615672; PP4_Moderate for classic Glanzmann thrombasthenia laboratory phenotype with absent aggregation to physiologic agonists except ristocetin and 6-7% alphaIIb/beta3 surface expression by flow cytometry in PMID:29615672) and two Supporting criteria (PM2_Supporting for absence from gnomAD [<0.0001]; PP3_Supporting for damaging in silico predictions across >2 independent predictors including BayesDel_noAF=0.594, AlphaMissense=0.997, SIFT=0, and PolyPhen-2=1.0) are met. Under ACMG/AMP combining rules, 2 Moderate + 2 Supporting criteria yield a classification of Likely Pathogenic (ACMG score = 6), concordant with the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP expert panel curation in ClinVar (VCV001691461).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Limb Girdle Muscular Dystrophy VCEP Specifications for SGCA Version 2.0 (doc_id: GN189). Met criteria are PM3 applied at Strong (4 points: confirmed in trans with pathogenic/likely pathogenic SGCA variants across multiple unrelated LGMD patients), PM5 applied at Supporting (1 point: likely pathogenic missense variant p.Arg221Pro at the same residue with REVEL=0.787 >0.70 and SpliceAI=0.02 <0.50), PP3 applied at Supporting (1 point: REVEL=0.787 ≥0.70), and PP4 applied at Supporting (1 point: patient phenotype specific for SGCA-related LGMD). PM2 is not met because the gnomAD v4.1 South Asian Grpmax AF (0.0003623) exceeds the VCEP cutoff (<0.00009). Under the GN189 Bayesian point-based combining rules (1 Strong [4 pts] + 3 Supporting [3 pts] = 7 points), a total score of 7 points falls within the 6 to 9 point range for Likely Pathogenic (also passes standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules: 1 Strong + ≥2 Supporting).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Limb Girdle Muscular Dystrophy VCEP specifications for SGCA v2.0 (GN189). aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Limb Girdle Muscular Dystrophy Expert Panel Specifications for SGCA Version 2.0 (doc_id: GN189). Four pathogenic criteria are met: PM3 applied at Strong (+4 points) based on compound heterozygosity in trans with pathogenic SGCA variants and homozygosity in multiple unrelated affected individuals; PP4 applied at Strong (+4 points) based on progressive limb-girdle muscle weakness with reduced alpha-sarcoglycan protein expression on muscle biopsy/immunoblotting; PP1 applied at Supporting (+1 point) for segregation in an affected relative (satisfying the GN189 rule that PP1 and PP4 together do not exceed 5 Bayesian points); and PP3 applied at Supporting (+1 point) for REVEL=0.754 (>=0.7 threshold). PM2 is not met because the gnomAD non-Finnish European allele frequency (0.0002205) exceeds the GN189 threshold (<0.00009). Under the GN189 point-based combining rules, the total score of 10 points (2 Strong + 2 Supporting) meets the threshold of >=10 points for a classification of Pathogenic.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Lysosomal Diseases VCEP specifications for GAA (doc_id: GN010, v2.0). Two pathogenic criteria are met: PVS1 at Very Strong (1 VS: frameshift variant p.Met122ArgfsTer20 creating a premature stop codon at codon 141, well upstream of codon 916) and PM2 at Moderate (1 M: gnomAD highest continental population MAF is 6.544e-05 in AMR, below the VCEP <0.001 threshold). Per ACMG/AMP combining rules, 1 Very Strong + 1 Moderate (1 VS + 1 M, ACMG score = 8 + 2 = 10) classifies the variant as Likely Pathogenic.

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Met at Strong per ClinGen LD VCEP (GN010) and ClinGen SVI splicing guidelines (PMID:37352859): intronic splice acceptor region variant c.-32-13T>G causes aberrant splicing with skipping of exon 2 (which contains the translation initiation codon) and ~10-20% residual normal transcript (PMID:34405923, PMID:30922962).
aiva_evidence.PS1: Not applicable: c.-32-13T>G is a non-coding intronic splice polypyrimidine tract variant per annotate_variant (VEP) and does not result in a same amino acid substitution (GN010).
aiva_evidence.PS2: Not applicable per ClinGen LD VCEP (GN010): de novo occurrence is not used as an evidence mechanism for GAA in Pompe disease.
aiva_evidence.PS3: Met at Moderate per ClinGen LD VCEP (GN010): well-established RT-PCR and functional splicing assays in patient fibroblasts and minigene constructs demonstrate mis-splicing (full and partial exon 2 skipping) for this non-canonical intronic variant with ~10-20% residual normal splice products and reduced GAA activity rescued by splice-correcting antisense oligonucleotides (PMID:34405923, PMID:30922962, PMID:28624228).
aiva_evidence.PS4: Not applicable per ClinGen LD VCEP (GN010): case-control studies are not applicable for recessive Pompe disease and affected proband counts are captured under PM3.

aiva_evidence.PM3: Met at Very Strong per ClinGen LD VCEP (GN010): observed in trans with multiple established pathogenic GAA variants (including c.525delT, c.1548G>A, c.2481+102_2646+31del, c.258dupC) and in affected homozygotes across numerous unrelated late-onset Pompe disease probands (>7 PM3 points, exceeding the 4.0-point threshold for Very Strong; PMID:27189384, PMID:37185710, PMID:35159144, PMID:34405923).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Lysosomal Diseases VCEP specifications for GAA (doc_id: GN010, Version 2.0; PMID:37907381). Pathogenic criteria met are 1 Very Strong (PM3_VeryStrong: >7 points from numerous compound heterozygous probands in trans with established pathogenic GAA variants and homozygous patients), 1 Strong (PVS1_Strong: RNA-confirmed leaky aberrant splicing causing exon 2 skipping and loss of the translation initiation codon with ~10-20% residual normal transcript), and 2 Moderate (PS3_Moderate: RT-PCR and functional assays confirming mis-splicing of a non-canonical intronic variant with residual normal splice product and reduced enzyme activity; PP4_Moderate: confirmed diagnostic GAA enzyme deficiency in affected patients). Per the ACMG/AMP and ClinGen LD VCEP combining rules, 1 Very Strong + 1 Strong + 2 Moderate criteria exceed the threshold for Pathogenic (1 VS + >=1 S or >=2 M), with a total ACMG score of 16.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications (doc_id: GN011, v2.1) and standard ACMG/AMP combining rules. Two Pathogenic Supporting criteria are met: PM2 (applied at Supporting strength per GN011 and ClinGen SVI 2020 because gnomAD v4.1 AF=6.20e-7 and popmax AF=1.33e-5 are <0.0001) and PP3 (applied at Supporting strength per GN011 and SVI calibration based on concordant damaging predictions including BayesDel_noAF=0.450, AlphaMissense=0.9843, SIFT=0, and PolyPhen-2=0.999). Although ClinVar lists this variant as Likely Pathogenic by expert panel review (ClinVar:1330310), variant-specific case-level (PM3/PP4) or functional (PS3) primary evidence was not available in the provided clinical context or indexed literature passages. With 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, and 2 Supporting pathogenic criteria (ACMG score = +2) and no benign criteria met, the variant does not reach the threshold for Likely Pathogenic and is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Lysosomal Diseases VCEP specifications for GAA (doc_id: GN010, Version 2.0). Two Moderate pathogenic criteria are met: PM2 at Moderate strength (absent from gnomAD per Ensembl VEP, meeting the <0.001 continental allele frequency threshold) and PM4 at Moderate strength (in-frame deletion of 3 amino acids, p.Arg154_Thr156del, which is >=2 amino acids and <1 exon in a non-repeat region). Combining 1 Strong (PM3_Strong) + 1 Moderate (PP4_Moderate) + 3 Supporting (PS3_Supporting, PM2_Supporting, PP3) satisfies the ACMG/AMP rules for Likely Pathogenic (both 1 Strong + 1–2 Moderate and 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting; total ACMG score = 4 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 9). (Note: Even if PM3 is counted conservatively at Moderate strength from the initial 2 probands = 1.0 point, 2 Moderate + 3 Supporting also yields Likely Pathogenic via the 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting rule).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Lysosomal Diseases VCEP specifications for GAA (doc_id: GN010, Version 2.0). Six pathogenic criteria are met: 1 Strong (PM3 applied at Strong based on >=2.0 points from multiple Pompe disease probands carrying c.2105G>A in trans/compound heterozygosity with pathogenic/likely pathogenic GAA variants), 2 Moderate (PM5 at Moderate due to established pathogenic missense variant p.Arg702Leu at the same residue; PP4 applied at Moderate due to multiple affected probands with documented GAA enzyme deficiency), and 3 Supporting (PS3 applied at Supporting for 13% residual cellular GAA activity in COS-7 cells; PM2 applied at Supporting for gnomAD continental popmax AF 0.00033 < 0.001; PP3 at Supporting for REVEL=0.985 > 0.7). Under the ACMG/AMP combining rules, 1 Strong + 2 Moderate + 3 Supporting satisfies Pathogenic rule (c) (1 Strong + 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting), yielding a classification of Pathogenic with an ACMG score of 11.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated strictly under the ClinGen Rett and Angelman-like Disorders VCEP specifications for TCF4 (Version 6.0, doc_id: GN032). The variant NM_001083962.1:c.2010_2011delGA (p.Gln670HisfsTer40) is a 2-bp frameshift deletion at the 3' end of the TCF4 coding sequence that abolishes the canonical termination codon at position 672 and causes a stop-codon read-through extending the protein by 37 amino acids into the 3'UTR. Per GN032, PVS1 (Very Strong) applies explicitly to 'Any frameshift variant that results in a read-through of the stop codon', and PM2 (Supporting) applies for complete absence in gnomAD control databases. Tallied met criteria by applied strength: 1 Very Strong (PVS1) and 1 Supporting (PM2_Supporting), yielding an ACMG point score of 8 + 1 = 9. Per the VCEP precedence rules, GN032's explicit combining_rules replace the generic combining rules entirely. Because GN032 requires at least 1 Very Strong + 1 Moderate for Likely Pathogenic (or 1 Very Strong + >=2 Supporting for Pathogenic) and does not include the ClinGen SVI 2020 rule of 1 Very Strong + 1 Supporting for Likely Pathogenic, the combination of 1 Very Strong + 1 Supporting does not reach Likely Pathogenic under the VCEP's combining_rules and is therefore classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic) (note: under the ClinGen SVI 2020 generic rule or point-based scoring of 9 points, 1 Very Strong + 1 Supporting would reach Likely Pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Congenital Myopathies Expert Panel Specifications for DNM2 Version 1.0 (doc_id: GN148). Four benign criteria are met: 1 Benign Stand-Alone (BA1, as the gnomAD allele frequency of ~2.19e-05 in exomes and ~1.97e-05 in genomes exceeds the VCEP BA1 threshold of >=1.5e-06), 1 Benign Strong (BS1, exceeding the VCEP threshold of >=1.5e-07), and 2 Benign Supporting (BP4 and BP7, based on synonymous consequence p.Asp218= with SpliceAI max_delta=0.002 showing no predicted splicing impact). aiva_rationale: Evaluated according to the ClinGen Familial Hypercholesterolemia VCEP specifications (GN013, v1.2). The variant NM_000527.5:c.542C>G (p.Pro181Arg) meets 2 Moderate criteria (PM2 at Moderate strength due to gnomAD v4.1 PopMax MAF of 0.0000161 ≤ 0.0002; PM1 at Moderate strength as a missense variant located in LDLR exon 4 that also meets PM2) and 1 Supporting criterion (PS4_Supporting, identified in ≥2 unrelated FH index cases in PMID:34297352 while meeting PM2). Computational prediction (REVEL = 0.713) falls in the intermediate range between the FH VCEP thresholds for PP3 (≥0.75) and BP4 (≤0.5), and co-located c.542C>T (p.Pro181Leu, ClinVar:431512) is classified as Likely Pathogenic rather than Pathogenic, leaving PM5 unmet under VCEP rules. Under the ACMG/AMP combining rules, 2 Moderate + 1 Supporting pathogenic criteria (ACMG score = 5) do not reach the threshold for Likely Pathogenic (which requires ≥3 Moderate or 2 Moderate + ≥2 Supporting), resulting in a classification of VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Familial Hypercholesterolemia VCEP specifications v1.2 (doc_id: GN013). Two Moderate pathogenic criteria are met: PM1 (Moderate, as p.Cys231Trp is a missense change in exon 4 affecting one of the conserved disulfide-bond-forming cysteine residues in the LDLR ligand-binding repeat domain while meeting PM2) and PM2 (Moderate per GN013, as the highest gnomAD subpopulation AF is 0.0001214, which is <=0.0002). aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Familial Hypercholesterolemia VCEP specifications (doc_id:GN013, v1.2). Functional characterization of LDLR c.806G>A (p.Gly269Asp) demonstrated 100% wild-type LDLR activity across expression, binding, and uptake (PMID:21990180; PMID:29874871), satisfying BS3 at Strong strength (1 BS). The gnomAD PopMax allele frequency (0.001317 in gnomAD v4.1 joint; 0.00144 in gnomADg AMR) is too high for PM2 (<=0.0002) — also precluding PM1, PS4, PM3, and PP4 under VCEP caveats — but does not reach the gnomAD FAF threshold of >=0.002 for BS1 or >=0.005 for BA1. The REVEL score of 0.661 falls in the indeterminate range between BP4 (<=0.50) and PP3 (>=0.75). With 1 Benign Strong criterion (BS3) and 0 Benign Supporting criteria (ACMG score = -4), the variant does not reach the threshold for Likely Benign (which requires 1 BS + 1 BP or >=2 BP) or Benign (>=2 BS), resulting in a classification of VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Familial Hypercholesterolemia VCEP specifications for LDLR (doc_id: GN013, Version 1.2; PMID:34906454), which use the standard ACMG/AMP combining rules (Richards et al. 2015). The variant meets 1 Strong (PS3), 2 Moderate (PM2, PM5), and 2 Supporting (PP3, PP4) pathogenic criteria, with no benign criteria met. Under ACMG/AMP and ClinGen FH VCEP combining rule Pathogenic (c) (1 Strong + 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting), the variant classifies as Pathogenic with an ACMG score of 10.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Familial Hypercholesterolemia Expert Panel Specifications (GN013, v1.2). Five pathogenic criteria are met: three at Moderate strength (PM2 at Moderate for absence from gnomAD; PS4 at Moderate for observation in 6 unrelated FH probands meeting validated clinical criteria; PP1 at Moderate for segregation in 4 informative meioses across 4 FH families) and two at Supporting strength (PP3 for REVEL=0.758 >= 0.75; PP4 for validated clinical FH phenotype in probands meeting DLCN/Simon Broome criteria). Combining 3 Moderate and 2 Supporting pathogenic criteria satisfies both the >=3 Moderate rule and the 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting rule for Likely Pathogenic (acmg_score = 8).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated according to the ClinGen Brain Malformations Variant Curation Expert Panel (BMVCEP) specifications (doc_id: GN018; PMID:35997716). Met criteria by applied strength are 1 Very Strong (PS4_VeryStrong: >40 unrelated probands with MPPH syndrome or bilateral perisylvian polymicrogyria, biochemical hyperactivation in patient cells, and somatic tumor occurrences in COSMIC totaling well over 16 points), 1 Strong (PS2_Strong: confirmed de novo germline and postzygotic somatic mosaic occurrences across affected probands), and 2 Supporting (PM1_Supporting: located in the critical PIK3R2 SH2 domain AA 328-716 per GN018 Table 3; PM2_Supporting: absent from gnomAD v2/v4 controls, AC=0). Under the ACMG/AMP combining rules and Bayesian point scale (score = 8 + 4 + 1 + 1 = 14), 1 Very Strong + >=1 Strong (as well as 1 Very Strong + >=2 Supporting) classifies the variant as Pathogenic.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012, v2.0) for autosomal dominant malignant hyperthermia susceptibility 1. Five pathogenic criteria are met, all at Moderate strength (0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 5 Moderate, 0 Supporting; acmg_score = 10): PS3 (Moderate: HEK293 in vitro Ca2+ release assays showing increased agonist sensitivity in PMID:16163667, PMID:26115329, PMID:31841587), PS4 (Moderate: 2.5 MH case points across 3 unrelated probands with popmax AF=0 <= 0.00006 in PMID:16163667, PMID:30236257, ClinGen:CA024467), PM1 (Moderate: residue 163 in the N-terminal hotspot residues 1-552 without concurrent PS1/PM5), PP1 (Moderate: co-segregation in 5 meioses in PMID:35718563, ClinGen:CA024467), and PP3 (Moderate: REVEL = 0.882 > 0.85 per GN012). PM2 is marked Not Applicable in GN012, and PM5 is not met because the alternate pathogenic variant at this residue (p.Arg163Cys, Grantham 180) has a higher Grantham score than p.Arg163Leu (Grantham 102). Because GN012 does not define custom combining_rules or points_rules in the specification object, applying the standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules yields Likely Pathogenic via the >=3 Moderate criteria rule (5 Moderate; note that under the Bayesian point system [PMID:29300386] used by the VCEP expert override in ClinGen, 5 Moderate = 10 points corresponds to Pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012, v2.0) for autosomal dominant malignant hyperthermia of anesthesia. Five pathogenic criteria are met: three at Moderate strength—PS2_Moderate (confirmed de novo in 1 affected individual = 2 points per GN012), PM1 (located at residue 178 within the N-terminal MHS mutational hotspot spanning residues 1-552), and PP3_Moderate (REVEL = 0.951, exceeding the >0.85 threshold)—and two at Supporting strength—PS4_Supporting (1 MH case point from a proband with MH history and positive IVCT/CHCT in PMID:16163667, and absent in gnomAD) and PP1_Supporting (segregation in 3 affected family members in PMID:16163667). It is absent from gnomAD, meeting PM2 at Supporting strength (1 Pathogenic Supporting, +1 point) under both GN150 and GN179. aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility Expert Panel Specifications for RYR1 Version 2.0 (GN012) for autosomal dominant malignant hyperthermia susceptibility 1. Two pathogenic criteria are met at Moderate strength: PM1 (Moderate: residue Asp544 lies within the defined N-terminal mutational hotspot region of residues 1-552) and PP3 (Moderate: REVEL score of 0.924 exceeds the VCEP threshold of >0.85). PM2 is marked Not Applicable as a standalone code by GN012 (which integrates absence/low allele frequency into PS4), and no variant-specific functional (PS3), case-point (PS4), de novo (PS2/PM6), or segregation (PP1) evidence was available in the clinical context or indexed literature. Combining 2 Pathogenic Moderate criteria (total ACMG score = 4; 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 2 Moderate, 0 Supporting) does not meet the threshold for Likely Pathogenic (which requires >=3 Moderate or 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting), resulting in a classification of VUS (leaning pathogenic).

With 1 Benign Strong criterion (BS1) and 0 Pathogenic or Benign Supporting criteria met (ACMG score = -4), the variant does not meet the combining rules for Likely Benign (which requires 1 BS + 1 BP or >=2 BP) or Benign (>=2 BS or BA1), resulting in a classification of VUS (leaning benign).

Its gnomAD popmax AF (1.67e-5 in gnomAD v4.1; 2.41e-5 in gnomADg AFR) is well below the GN012 BS1 (>0.0008) and BA1 (>0.0038) thresholds. No MHS case-level points (PS4), de novo occurrences (PS2/PM6), segregation (PP1), or functional assays (PS3/BS3) were identified in the biomedical literature. With 0 pathogenic and 0 benign criteria met (acmg_score = 0), no Pathogenic, Likely Pathogenic, Benign, or Likely Benign combining rule fires, resulting in a classification of VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated using the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012, Version 2.0) for autosomal dominant malignant hyperthermia susceptibility. Five pathogenic criteria are met: 3 at Moderate strength (PS1_Moderate, PS3_Moderate, PS4_Moderate) and 2 at Supporting strength (PM1_Supporting, PM5_Supporting), with 0 benign criteria met. Under the ACMG/AMP 2015 and ClinGen VCEP combining rules, 3 Moderate criteria (>=3 M) as well as 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting criteria (2 M + 2 P) both satisfy the requirements for Likely Pathogenic (acmg_score = 3*2 + 2*1 = 8), matching the ClinGen Expert Panel curation (ClinVar:1210320 / ClinGen:CA405667782).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated for the stated autosomal dominant phenotype of malignant hyperthermia susceptibility 1 under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (GN012). One Benign Strong criterion (BS1: gnomAD v4.1 NFE popmax AF = 0.001518 > 0.0008 threshold in GN012) and one Pathogenic Moderate criterion (PM1: residue 2321 falls within the GN012-defined central mutational hotspot residues 2,101-2,458) are met. Under the ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules (as GN012 does not define custom combining rules), 1 Pathogenic Moderate (PM1) does not meet Pathogenic or Likely Pathogenic, and 1 Benign Strong (BS1) alone without a Benign Supporting criterion (REVEL = 0.712 is between the GN012 BP4 threshold of <0.5 and PP3 threshold of >0.85) does not reach Benign (>=2 BS or BA1) or Likely Benign (1 BS + 1 BP or >=2 BP). Because Benign Strong (-4 points) outweighs Pathogenic Moderate (+2 points, net ACMG score = -2), the variant is classified as VUS (leaning benign) for malignant hyperthermia susceptibility (whereas under the Congenital Myopathies AD VCEP GN150, its AF exceeds the lower myopathy BA1 threshold of 0.0000486).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (GN012; PMID:33767344) and ClinGen Evidence Repository curation (ClinGen:CA024665). Met pathogenic criteria total 2 Moderate (PS3_Moderate, PM1) and 1 Supporting (PP1) (+5 points), which do not independently reach Likely Pathogenic. Met benign criteria total 2 Benign Strong (BS1, BS2) (-8 points). Combining all met criteria using the ClinGen VCEP Bayesian point-based framework (PMID:29300386, PMID:33767344; net ACMG score = +2 + 2 + 1 - 4 - 4 = -3 points, within the -1 to -5 Likely Benign interval; posterior probability ~0.018) yields a classification of Likely Benign.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012, Version 2.0; PMID:33767344) for autosomal dominant malignant hyperthermia susceptibility 1. Two criteria are met at Moderate strength: PM1 (Moderate), as p.Glu2348Gly lies in the central mutational hotspot (residues 2,101-2,458), and PP3 (Moderate), as REVEL=0.964 exceeds the VCEP threshold of >0.85. Two criteria are met at Supporting strength: PS4 (Supporting), based on unrelated MHS probands with positive IVCT and gnomAD popmax AF <=0.00006 (PMID:14985404, PMID:27857962, PMID:36208971), and PP1 (Supporting), based on co-segregation in an affected UK family (PMID:14985404, PMID:27857962). Combining 2 Moderate (PM1, PP3_Moderate) and 2 Supporting (PS4_Supporting, PP1) pathogenic criteria satisfies the ACMG/AMP combining rule for Likely Pathogenic (2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting; ACMG score = 6).

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Not met: marked Not Applicable per ClinGen MHS VCEP specification GN012 (MHS is caused by gain-of-function variants in RYR1, and NM_000540.3:c.6488G>A is a missense variant p.Arg2163His).
aiva_evidence.PS1: Not met: NM_000540.3:c.6488G>A is the canonical nucleotide substitution encoding p.Arg2163His with no other established pathogenic nucleotide change resulting in the same amino acid substitution.
aiva_evidence.PS2: Not met: no confirmed de novo occurrence in the clinical context or literature for this assessment under ClinGen MHS VCEP GN012.
aiva_evidence.PS3: Met at Moderate strength (PS3_Moderate) per ClinGen MHS VCEP GN012: well-established in vitro functional assays in HEK293 cells and myotubes expressing RYR1 p.Arg2163His demonstrate increased sensitivity to RYR1 agonists (caffeine/halothane) and significantly increased Ca2+ release compared to wild-type (PMID:11524458, PMID:28687594, PMID:35428369, PMID:35980353; ClinVar:12974).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012) for autosomal dominant malignant hyperthermia susceptibility. aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (GN012) for autosomal dominant malignant hyperthermia susceptibility. Three pathogenic criteria are met from the available evidence: PM1 at Moderate strength (p.Arg2359Gln is located at residue 2359 within the RYR1 central mutational hotspot spanning residues 2,101-2,458), PP3 at Moderate strength (REVEL = 0.873 > 0.85 threshold per GN012), and PS4 at Supporting strength (1.0 MH case point from a proband with a clinical MH crisis and positive IVCT in PMID:24433488, with gnomAD v4.1 popmax AF = 3.379e-05 <= 0.00006 per GN012; note that an additional published case in PMID:37781817 presented with exertional rhabdomyolysis without a documented MH crisis or IVCT/CHCT). No benign criteria are met, and PM2 is marked Not Applicable by GN012. Combining 2 Pathogenic Moderate (PM1, PP3_Moderate) and 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PS4_Supporting) criteria yields an ACMG score of 5 points, which falls one Supporting criterion or one Moderate upgrade short of the Likely Pathogenic thresholds (2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting, or >=3 Moderate) under the ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules, resulting in VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility Variant Curation Expert Panel (VCEP) specifications for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012) for the autosomal dominant phenotype of malignant hyperthermia susceptibility 1. aiva_rationale: Evaluated using the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012) for the stated phenotype of malignant hyperthermia susceptibility 1 (autosomal dominant). Only 1 Benign Strong criterion (BS1) is met based on the gnomAD popmax allele frequency of 0.161% (0.001608 in gnomAD v4.1; 0.001791 in gnomAD v2.1.1 controls NFE), which exceeds the VCEP BS1 threshold of 0.08% (0.0008) but is below the BA1 threshold of 0.38% (0.0038). The REVEL score of 0.693 falls in the intermediate range between the VCEP BP4 (<0.50) and PP3 (>0.85) cutoffs, and no functional or case-level pathogenic evidence was met. Under ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules (where Likely Benign requires 1 BS + 1 BP or >=2 BP, and Benign requires >=2 BS or BA1), 1 Benign Strong criterion alone (acmg_score = -4) results in a classification of VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Congenital Myopathies VCEP autosomal recessive specification for RYR1 (doc_id: GN179). The met criteria total 1 Pathogenic Strong (PM3 applied at Strong based on >=2.0 allelic points across unrelated autosomal recessive RYR1-related myopathy probands in PMID:24951453, PMID:23826317, and PMID:38968056) and 5 Pathogenic Supporting (PS3_Supporting from reduced RYR1 protein on patient muscle biopsy in PMID:23826317, PM2_Supporting with gnomAD popmax AF 3.39e-6 <= 6.97e-6, PP1 at Supporting from sibling and family segregation, PP3 at Supporting with REVEL 0.841 >= 0.7, and PP4 at Supporting from specific muscle biopsy/MRI phenotype after multi-gene exclusion). Under the GN179 combining rules, 1 Pathogenic Strong + >=2 Pathogenic Supporting yields a classification of Likely Pathogenic (ACMG score = 9).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated using the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (GN012, Version 2.0) for the stated autosomal dominant phenotype of malignant hyperthermia susceptibility 1. One Benign Strong criterion is met: BS1 (Strong), based on gnomAD v4.1 popmax AF=0.001608 and gnomAD v2.1.1 controls NFE popmax AF=0.001791 exceeding the GN012 BS1 threshold of >0.0008 (while remaining below the GN012 BA1 threshold of >0.0038). Neither PP3 nor BP4 is met because REVEL=0.693 falls in the intermediate range between the GN012 thresholds (<0.5 for BP4 and >0.85 for PP3). Because GN012 does not include custom combining_rules in the VCEP specification record, applying the standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules to 1 Benign Strong (BS1) and 0 Benign Supporting criteria (requiring >=2 BS for Benign or 1 BS + 1 BP / >=2 BP for Likely Benign) yields VUS (leaning benign) with an ACMG score of -4.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012, Version 2.0; Johnston et al. 2021, PMID:33767344) for autosomal dominant malignant hyperthermia susceptibility 1. Ten criteria (PVS1, PM2, PM3, PM4, PP2, PP4, BS4, BP1, BP3, BP5) are designated Not Applicable by GN012. Six pathogenic criteria are met: PS3 at Moderate strength (HEK293 in vitro Ca2+ release assay showing increased caffeine sensitivity; PMID:27586648), PS4 at Moderate strength (multiple unrelated MHS probands with clinical MH episodes and positive IVCT/CHCT accumulating 2-6 case points with gnomAD popmax AF <= 0.00006; PMID:10484775, PMID:10612851, PMID:24433488), PM5 at Moderate strength (established pathogenic missense variant p.Arg2454His at the same residue with lower Grantham score 29 vs 180; PMID:10051009, PMID:33767344), PP3 at Moderate strength (REVEL = 0.913 > 0.85 threshold per annotate_variant and GN012), PM1 at Supporting strength (central hotspot residue 2454 within 2101-2458, downgraded to Supporting when combined with PM5 per GN012), and PP1 at Supporting strength (co-segregation in 3-4 meioses; PMID:10484775, PMID:10612851, PMID:33767344). Combining 4 Moderate (PS3_Moderate, PS4_Moderate, PM5, PP3_Moderate) and 2 Supporting (PM1_Supporting, PP1) criteria satisfies the ACMG/AMP rule for Likely Pathogenic (>=3 Moderate criteria, as well as 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting criteria) with an ACMG point score of 10.

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Not applicable: per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012), PVS1 is not applicable because malignant hyperthermia susceptibility (MHS) is caused by gain-of-function variants in RYR1, and NM_000540.3:c.7361G>A (p.Arg2454His) is a missense variant.
aiva_evidence.PS1: Not met: no different nucleotide change resulting in the same p.Arg2454His amino acid substitution has been established as pathogenic per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012).
aiva_evidence.PS2: Not met: no confirmed de novo occurrences of NM_000540.3:c.7361G>A were identified in the clinical context or literature per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012).
aiva_evidence.PS3: Met at Moderate strength: functional studies in HEK293 cells (PMID:28687594, PMID:32381029) and ex vivo patient B-lymphocytes (PMID:19191333, PMID:32381029) demonstrate significantly increased sensitivity to RYR1 agonists (caffeine/4-CmC) and enhanced Ca2+ release compared to wild-type, meeting PS3 at Moderate strength per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012).
aiva_evidence.PS4: Met at Strong strength: identified in numerous unrelated probands with clinical MH events and/or positive IVCT/CHCT testing (≥7 MH case points across PMID:10051009, PMID:11575529, PMID:12059893, PMID:24433488, PMID:36245440, PMID:37154182) with gnomAD v2.1.1 exome AF=6.842e-06 and gnomAD v4.1 joint AF=6.197e-06 per annotate_variant, meeting PS4 at Strong strength per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012).
aiva_evidence.PM1: Met at Moderate strength: p.Arg2454His (residue 2454) is located within the well-established central region mutational hotspot of RYR1 (residues 2,101-2,458) per annotate_variant and ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012), and neither PS1 nor PM5 is applied.
aiva_evidence.PM2: Not applicable: per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012), PM2 is marked Not Applicable and is not used as an independent criterion for RYR1 malignant hyperthermia susceptibility.
aiva_evidence.PM3: Not applicable: per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012), PM3 is not applicable because MHS is inherited as an autosomal dominant trait.
aiva_evidence.PM4: Not applicable: per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012), PM4 is marked Not Applicable for MHS, and NM_000540.3:c.7361G>A is a missense variant that does not alter protein length.
aiva_evidence.PM5: Not met: although p.Arg2454Cys (c.7360C>T) is an established pathogenic missense variant at the same residue (PMID:10612851, PMID:24433488, PMID:33564012), ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012) requires the Grantham score of the alternate pathogenic variant (Arg>Cys, Grantham=180) to be less than that of the variant being assessed (Arg>His, Grantham=29); since 180 > 29, PM5 is not met.
aiva_evidence.PM6: Not met: no assumed de novo occurrences without parental confirmation were reported in the clinical context or literature per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012).
aiva_evidence.PP1: Met at Supporting strength: co-segregation of p.Arg2454His with malignant hyperthermia susceptibility was demonstrated in a large Italian pedigree (PMID:10051009) and an affected parent-offspring family (PMID:36245440), meeting PP1 at Supporting strength per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012).
aiva_evidence.PP2: Not applicable: per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012), PP2 is marked Not Applicable for RYR1.
aiva_evidence.PP3: Met at Moderate strength: REVEL score is 0.923 per annotate_variant, which exceeds the ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012) threshold of >0.85 for applying PP3 at Moderate strength (PMID:33767344).
aiva_evidence.PP4: Not applicable: per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012), PP4 is not applicable because variants in other genes such as CACNA1S also result in MHS.
aiva_evidence.BA1: Not met: gnomAD v4.1 popmax AF is 0.00017094 (overall AF=6.197e-06; gnomAD v2.1.1 highest continental AF=2.988e-05 in AFR) per annotate_variant, which is well below the ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012) BA1 threshold of >0.0038 (0.38%).
aiva_evidence.BS1: Not met: gnomAD v4.1 popmax AF is 0.00017094 (overall AF=6.197e-06) per annotate_variant, which is below the ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012) BS1 threshold of >0.0008 (0.08%).
aiva_evidence.BS2: Not met: no variant-positive individuals with negative IVCT/CHCT results were identified in the literature per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012).
aiva_evidence.BS3: Not met: functional studies demonstrate a damaging gain-of-function effect rather than normal channel activity (PMID:19191333, PMID:28687594, PMID:32381029) per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012).
aiva_evidence.BS4: Not applicable: per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012), BS4 is not applicable due to the false-positive rate of IVCT/CHCT phenotyping and incomplete penetrance of MH crises.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specification for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012) for the stated phenotype of autosomal dominant malignant hyperthermia susceptibility 1. One pathogenic criterion is met at Supporting strength (PS4_Supporting: 1 MH case point from a proband with clinical MH rank 6 and enhanced Ca2+ release in PMID:16732084 / PMID:32535660, with popmax AF = 0 <= 0.00006 in population databases), and one benign criterion is met at Supporting strength (BS3_Supporting: HEK293 and myotube Ca2+ release assays in PMID:32535660 showed no increased agonist sensitivity for p.Lys3367Arg compared to wild-type RYR1). Notably, PM2 is marked Not Applicable alone by GN012, p.Lys3367Arg lies outside the GN012 PM1 hotspots (1-552, 2101-2458, 4631-4991), and REVEL (0.632) falls in the intermediate range between the GN012 BP4 (<0.5) and PP3 (>0.85) thresholds. With 1 Pathogenic Supporting (+1 point) and 1 Benign Supporting (-1 point), neither Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic nor Benign/Likely Benign combining rules are satisfied (net ACMG score = 0). Because variant-specific functional testing (PMID:32535660) demonstrated normal RYR1 channel Ca2+ sensitivity and concluded that MH in the carrier may be due to another gene, the variant is classified as VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Congenital Myopathies VCEP specification for autosomal recessive RYR1-related myopathy (GN179 v2.0). Met criteria totals: 1 Pathogenic Very Strong (PVS1) and 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2 applied at Supporting strength, PM2_Supporting), giving an ACMG score of 9 (8 + 1). Under GN179's explicit combining_rules (which govern verbatim and do not include a 1 Very Strong + 1 Supporting rule for Likely Pathogenic, requiring either 1 Very Strong + 1 Moderate for Likely Pathogenic or 1 Very Strong + >=2 Supporting for Pathogenic), no Pathogenic or Likely Pathogenic combining rule fires; therefore, the variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic) based on strong pathogenic evidence weight.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility Variant Curation Expert Panel (VCEP) specifications for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012, Version 2.0) and ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules. Four criteria are met at Moderate strength (0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 4 Moderate, 0 Supporting; acmg_score = 8): PS3 (applied at Moderate strength based on HEK293 in vitro calcium release assays showing increased sensitivity to caffeine in PMID:28403410), PS4 (applied at Moderate strength based on multiple unrelated MH families with positive IVCTs in PMID:19648156 and PMID:28403410, with gnomAD popmax AF <=0.00006), PP1 (applied at Moderate strength based on segregation with MHS in 5-6 meioses per PMID:28403410 and VCEP curation), and PP3 (applied at Moderate strength based on REVEL = 0.868 > 0.85 threshold per GN012). Under the combining rules, >=3 Moderate pathogenic criteria (4 Moderate met) without any Strong or Very Strong criteria satisfies the rule for Likely Pathogenic.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specification for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012, Version 2.0) for autosomal dominant malignant hyperthermia susceptibility 1. aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012, Version 2.0) and standard ACMG/AMP combining rules. Five pathogenic criteria are met: 3 Strong (PS3 at Strong based on knock-in T4826I-RYR1 mouse models demonstrating both in vivo anesthetic/heat-triggered MH reactions and ex vivo increased agonist sensitivity/Ca2+ release; PS4 at Strong based on >=7 MH case points across multiple unrelated MHS probands with gnomAD popmax AF <= 0.00006; PP1 at Strong based on co-segregation across >=7 meioses with LOD = 11.103 in a large MHS pedigree), 1 Moderate (PP3 at Moderate with REVEL = 0.977 > 0.85), and 1 Supporting (PM1 at Supporting for location at residue 4826 in the C-terminal critical domain, residues 4631-4991). With 3 Strong, 1 Moderate, and 1 Supporting pathogenic criteria (ACMG score = 15) and no benign criteria met, the variant meets the combining rules for Pathogenic (>=2 Strong; and 1 Strong + 1 Moderate + >=1 Supporting).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012, Version 2.0). Four pathogenic criteria are met: two at Moderate strength — PS3_Moderate (replicated HEK293 in vitro and ex vivo Ca2+ release assays showing significantly increased sensitivity to RYR1 agonist 4-chloro-m-cresol in PMID:18212565, PMID:20461000, PMID:23459219, and PMID:28527222) and PP3_Moderate (REVEL = 0.975 > 0.85 threshold per GN012) — and two at Supporting strength — PM1_Supporting (located at residue 4833 within the C-terminal critical domain of residues 4,631-4,991 per GN012) and PS4_Supporting (identified in probands with fatal MH reactions and family members with positive IVCT in PMID:18212565 and PMID:20482855, yielding >=1 MH case point with popmax AF <= 0.00006). Under standard ACMG/AMP and ClinGen VCEP combining rules, 2 Moderate + 2 Supporting criteria yield a classification of Likely Pathogenic (ACMG score = 2 + 2 + 1 + 1 = 6).

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Not applicable per ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP (GN012) and AD Congenital Myopathies VCEP (GN150): loss of function is not an established disease mechanism for autosomal dominant RYR1-related malignant hyperthermia susceptibility (which is caused by gain-of-function variants), consistent with gnomAD constraint (pLI=8.66e-57, LOEUF=0.641 per annotate_variant).
aiva_evidence.PS1: Not met: this variant is a deletion/splice-disrupting frameshift variant (c.14510del / c.14511_14511+1del, p.Gln4837ArgfsTer3) rather than a missense substitution producing the same amino acid change as an established pathogenic variant (GN012).

aiva_evidence.PS3: Not met: although PMID:17293538 reported altered stability of heteromeric RyR1 channels in HEK293 cells and PMID:42644805 showed partial in-frame skipping of exon 100 in skeletal muscle RNA (5.7%-12.9% of transcripts), the studies do not meet ClinGen VCEP (GN012) requirements for PS3 (no knock-in mouse model, fewer than two independent ex vivo Ca2+ release studies, and no HEK293 agonist hyper-sensitivity assay calibrated with known pathogenic and benign controls).
aiva_evidence.PS4: Met at Supporting strength per ClinGen VCEP (GN012): the variant is absent from gnomAD (popmax <=0.00006 per annotate_variant) and was identified in an index proband with a personal history of an anesthesia-induced malignant hyperthermia crisis (0.5 points) and positive in vitro contracture test (IVCT, 0.5 points) in a family with 3 MHS-positive individuals (PMID:17293538, PMID:42644805), totaling 1.0 MH case point (threshold >=1 point for PS4_Supporting).

aiva_evidence.PM2: Not applicable per ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP (GN012), which specifies that PM2 is not used for autosomal dominant MHS curation despite the variant's absence from gnomAD per annotate_variant.
aiva_evidence.PM3: Not applicable per ClinGen VCEP (GN012, GN150): malignant hyperthermia susceptibility is inherited in an autosomal dominant manner, so in trans biallelic recessive scoring does not apply.
aiva_evidence.PM4: Not applicable per ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP (GN012): PM4 is marked not applicable for MHS as causative variants are predominantly missense, and the coding consequence is a frameshift/splice variant rather than a simple non-repeat in-frame indel or stop-loss.
aiva_evidence.PM5: Not met: this variant is not a missense substitution at a residue with a previously established pathogenic missense variant (GN012).
aiva_evidence.PM6: Not met: no assumed de novo cases without parental confirmation were reported in the clinical context or literature (GN012).
aiva_evidence.PP1: Not met: in the reported pedigree (PMID:17293538, PMID:42644805), 8 family members carried c.14510delA and 5 underwent IVCT testing, of whom 3 tested MHS-positive and 2 tested MHN-negative, which is fewer than the >=3 MHS-segregating meioses required for PP1_Supporting under ClinGen VCEP (GN012).
aiva_evidence.PP2: Not applicable per ClinGen VCEP (GN012, GN150): PP2 is marked not applicable for RYR1, and the variant is not a missense change.

aiva_evidence.BA1: Not met: the variant is absent from gnomAD per annotate_variant, well below the ClinGen VCEP (GN012) BA1 popmax threshold of >0.0038.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (GN012, with splicing computational threshold reference from RYR1 VCEP GN150 and ClinGen SVI). PVS1 and PM2 are not applicable per GN012 because autosomal dominant malignant hyperthermia susceptibility acts via a gain-of-function mechanism rather than haploinsufficiency/loss of function, and PM2 is not applied in GN012. Two Pathogenic Supporting criteria are met: PS4 (applied at Supporting strength for 1.0 MH case point from the proband with an anesthesia MH crisis and positive IVCT in PMID:17293538 and PMID:42644805, with absence from gnomAD) and PP3 (applied at Supporting strength for SpliceAI donor loss delta score >=0.5 per annotate_variant and PMID:42644805). With 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, and 2 Supporting pathogenic criteria (ACMG score = 2) and 0 benign criteria, the evidence does not meet the threshold for Likely Pathogenic and classifies as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specification for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012). Four pathogenic criteria are met: 1 Pathogenic Strong (PP1 applied at Strong for co-segregation in >=7 meioses across >10 affected/susceptible individuals in PMID:19918671), 2 Pathogenic Moderate (PS4 applied at Moderate for 2.0 MH case points across 2 unrelated probands with positive IVCT/CHCT in PMID:19918671 and PMID:21455645 and absence from gnomAD; PP3 applied at Moderate for REVEL = 0.962 > 0.85), and 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM1 applied at Supporting for location at residue 4935 in the C-terminal MHS hotspot region 4,631-4,991). Under the ACMG/AMP and ClinGen VCEP combining rules, 1 Strong + 2 Moderate (+ 1 Supporting) does not meet the threshold for Pathogenic (which requires 1 Strong + >=3 Moderate or 1 Strong + 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting) and fires the rule 1 Strong + 1-2 Moderate for Likely Pathogenic (ACMG score = 4 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 9).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Monogenic Diabetes Expert Panel Specifications for HNF4A Version 4.0 (doc_id: GN085). Two pathogenic criteria are met: PM1 at Moderate strength (c.-181G>A resides at position c.-181 within the c.-178 to c.-181 direct HNF1A/HNF1B binding site in the HNF4A P2 promoter, explicitly designated for PM1_Moderate by GN085 per PMID:23332764 and PMID:38909044) and PM2 at Supporting strength (absent from gnomAD per annotate_variant VEP lookup, meeting gnomAD Grpmax FAF <= 0.000003 per GN085). Although ClinVar lists pathogenic submissions for rs2146126966 (VCV001299755) and PMID:38855865 investigates P2-HNF4A promoter variants in European MODY families, variant-specific case counts, segregation meioses, and specific functional assay values for c.-181G>A were not available in the retrieved tool outputs to satisfy PS3, PS4, PP1, or PP4. Combining 1 Moderate (PM1, +2 points) and 1 Supporting (PM2, +1 point) yields an ACMG score of 3, which does not reach the GN085 threshold for Likely Pathogenic (requiring at least 1 Moderate + >=4 Supporting or 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting) and therefore results in a classification of VUS (leaning pathogenic).
